method: Prototype pass, no renames: every proposal repeats the CURRENT applied name (r4a functions.csv) with kind function and a signature. thiscall-fix: Ghidra 12.1.4 CParser (Base-src.zip CParser.java applyFunctionQualifiers/CParserConstants) has tokens for __cdecl/__stdcall/__fastcall/__vectorcall/__rustcall/pascal but NOT __thiscall, so "ret __thiscall X(void *this, ...)" and the importer degraded fallback (which keeps the keyword) failed. FORM USED: "ret __fastcall X(void *pThis, int edx_unused, <stack args>)": ECX=this, EDX=unused dummy, the rest on the stack, callee-cleaned, the same ABI as MSVC thiscall; checked that the RET imm in each body equals the stack-arg bytes (this excluded) and the push count at direct call sites. The parameter is named pThis, not this (Ghidra reserves this for its auto-parameter); TitanInterface has no /Cataclysm type, so it is void *. Game-*/Ships-other: real-named class hw1:* functions whose latest apply status (r1->r2->r3 cet_apply_report; a later name-only entry keeps an earlier prototype) is no-proto (623, 429 of them round-3 names); degraded: every function still proto-applied-degraded (342: 259 cat-new round-1 producer types written before the A2 types existed, 83 hw1). Declaration source, in order: HomeworldSDL .c definition (named file, then any HomeworldSDL or gardens-of-kadesh src file), the .h prototype, a CET game declaration, a CET-commented Relic decl (capped medium), and for degraded entries the symbol-file type itself re-translated (capped medium). Types: names known to the program DTM (r4a datatypes.h) or the A2 clang catalog kept verbatim; bool->sdword in C (C++/CET bool kept), HW1-only enums->sdword, HW1-only fn-pointer typedefs (aieHandlerShips/Int/Simple, pingeval, ...) and inline fn pointers->void *, HW1-only struct pointers->void *, arrays->pointers; every final signature was re-checked to contain only type names present in r4a datatypes.h. Checks against the binary (objdump of cataclysm.exe, function starts from r4a): RET imm (0 -> __cdecl, == arg bytes -> __stdcall/thiscall, else dropped), caller cleanup (add esp,N / pop ecx) and pushes before each direct call, r4a decompiled body (in_stack_ reads past the args, Ghidra-found param bytes > declared, pointer/float use per param). NEW in r4: Cataclysm ETG/particle function-table entries take ONE pointer to an argument array (etgFsub 0x0046fe10: return *param_1 - param_1[1]; partSetDeltaColorDist reads param_1[0..2]) where HW1 declares N args: such bodies (single Ghidra param indexed [k>=1], no pushing direct callers, HW1 >=2 args) and every ETG.c one-arg table function with no direct callers (etgSin: fsin(*param_1); etgDamageDone: *(*param_1+0xe8); etgFloat2Int: mov eax,[esp+4]; fld [eax]) are dropped as etg-arg-array (the round-3 audit dropped the same family); a later pass could give them "<ret> f(<T> *args)". The thiscall-fix keeps the round-3 prototypes-set confidence; low when weak stack evidence. high = >=2 agreeing stack facts and no contradiction, capped at the name confidence; one weak contradiction -> low; any strong one -> dropped. missions: HW1 src/Game/KAS.h typedef void (*KASInitFunction)(void) / KASWatchFunction(void); kas2c.c:1564/1656 emit "void %s(void);"; Cataclysm kasExecute 0x004906d0 calls them as "call ecx/eax" with nothing pushed, kasJump 0x00490640 tail-jumps "jmp [esp+8]" to Init; over all 2,085 r4a bodies in 0x5d6fe0-0x670a0f: param_count 0, no in_stack_/param_ reads, no value returned, RET imm 0 in 2,044 and a tail jmp to a 0-arg kasf in 41. Signature void __cdecl NAME(void), class cat-new (as in missions-r2). Per subsystem: thiscall-fix: 77 of 77 rewritten (high 54, low 6, medium 17), 0 dropped (none); Game-a-f: 108 proposed of 181 (high 17, low 8, medium 83), dropped: caller-cleanup 5, etg-arg-array 46, ghidra-params 8, push-count 12, stack-read 1, body-differs 72, no-decl 1; Game-g-m: 51 proposed of 70 (high 5, medium 46), dropped: caller-cleanup 5, ghidra-params 4, push-count 10, body-differs 19; Game-n-s: 153 proposed of 204 (high 34, low 2, medium 117), dropped: caller-cleanup 5, etg-arg-array 31, ghidra-params 4, param-kinds 1, push-count 10, body-differs 51; Game-t-z: 71 proposed of 78 (high 12, low 3, medium 56), dropped: caller-cleanup 1, ghidra-params 1, push-count 5, body-differs 7; Ships-other: 31 proposed of 90 (high 4, low 2, medium 25), dropped: caller-cleanup 9, ghidra-params 2, push-count 4, ret-mismatch 5, body-differs 20, no-decl 37, untranslatable 2; degraded: 301 proposed of 342 (high 5, low 11, medium 285), dropped: caller-cleanup 18, push-count 17, stack-read 6, body-differs 41; missions: 2085 proposed (Init 840, Watch 1245; all high), 0 skipped (none).
